Focus restore is C5 #37861's, and this card only makes a favourite open the same target as a history row (ADR-0057 A5 row 5). (2) On the A4 问 AI page, where `open()` returns early for a non-handoff target (useConsoleChatDock.tsx:184-185), a favourite falls back to href navigation to its `/ai/…` address. Route: id `conversation:ID`, storing conversationId and agent, href from `aiAddressOf`; the sidebar reads the details of shown conversation favourites (≤ 8) once on mount, refreshes the label when the title changed and marks it unavailable when unreadable (in memory only).
Thread-read: none
Premise: holds on origin/main 4de4e3e9. The type table is at FavoritesProvider.tsx:62 (no conversation type), href is required, and the cap of 20 is at :144. `control.open` is at useConsoleChatDock.tsx:182, and with a target it only expands the sidebar, so opening in place works. The sidebar favourite row is a Link (UnifiedSidebar.tsx:693-713) and needs a non-link branch. Cloud C6 (cloud#5113) is merged per epic:#5027#1. Jack's ruling 7221127130 starts it now.
Serial constraints cleared: `C4 PR #37970 draws the new drawer header row ("No ☆ (C8)"): the provider, sidebar, unavailability and title work goes first on main; the ☆ is added after C4 merges, via a real merge of main (no rebase, no force-push). The thread runs overlap-check against #37970, #37924 and the other open 问 AI PRs before its first push.`
